Celecoxib in oncology: targeting the COX-2/PGE Celecoxib, a selective cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2) inhibitor, has emerged as a multifaceted therapeutic agent in oncology due to its dual anti-inflammatory and antitumor properties. This review synthesizes recent advances in understanding the molecular mechanisms and clinical applications of celecoxib in cancer treatment.
